address: Balboaplein 48, Amsterdam-West (Bos en Lommer): 2004 perimeter housing block of red brick with deep balcony loggias on the south, ribbon-window north front and slate-grey clad upper storeys on the east, around courtyards
notes: Balboaplein 48 (BAG pand 0363100012147097, built 2004, 359 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 20.3 m): a large 2004 perimeter block of social and private housing in Bos en Lommer, four to five storeys of dark red brick round three courtyards, with the street-side upper floors on the east clad in grey-blue slate scales over a red brick base. Six walls have panoramas; three are drawn: the south front (w02-170, 2024-12-06), the north front (w03-350, 2021-02-22) and the east front (w05-80, 2019-04-30; w04-80 and w06-80 show the same slate-clad east wings); the long west front (w01-260, 2017-04-20, a 72 m crop of a glazed community building in red brick and grey) is not drawn.

walls[0] = panel 103 (S, 38.2 m, eaves 14.9): red brick, five floors, large slab-edged loggia balconies in alternate bays over a glazed brick ground; drawn as 5 storeys x 8 bays with solid-rail balconies in every second bay on storeys 2-4. walls[1] = panel 19 (N, 38.2 m, eaves 14.8): the same red brick with ribbon-like paired windows, 5 storeys x 8 bays. walls[2] = panel 73 (E, 23.3 m, eaves 14.8): grey-blue slate cladding with paired white-framed windows over a red brick ground, drawn as 5 storeys x 6 bays in a slate colour.

Simplified: the red brick ground storey of the east wing takes the slate colour with the floors above (one palette per group), the slate scale pattern is a flat colour, the deep loggias are slab balconies in alternate bays, window sizes are one pattern per group; the stepped slate roofs and roof terraces are 3DBAG roof geometry. Not drawn: the west front, the courtyard faces and the wings between, which stay blank brick.
